title: Console Tooling Standup - 2026-08-11
agenda: UI bug triage - header/nav and beta flag UX

Customer impact: flagged a customer on Dedicated (AcmeHealth) who might see blips if rollback triggers; CS aware and will notify if we hit rollback threshold.
Docs: canary runbook needs a short section on rollback communication template. Asha to add a snippet to Confluence page.
